# #103 — openbrain-memory python client: no session-expiry retry (diverges from rtech-hermes HttpTransport)

State: CLOSED
Author: Skippy-the-Magnificent-one
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-12T01:21:17Z
Updated: 2026-06-15T21:08:43Z

Surfaced by the rtech-hermes PR #41 review swarm (retry-on-session-expired, rtech-hermes#36).

`python/openbrain-memory` `OpenBrainClient.call_tool` has no expiry handling: after the 30-minute MCP session TTL (`SESSION_TTL_MS`, src/transport.ts), a call on the expired session surfaces the 400 ("Bad request: missing session or not an initialize request") as a protocol error instead of re-initializing and retrying.

`docs/sme/domain-backend.md` (dual-client entry) requires MCP session TTL behavior verified against BOTH clients. The rtech-hermes `HttpTransport` now: detects session-gone responses (400 with the "missing session" body marker, or 404 per MCP spec), re-runs the initialize handshake, and retries the original call exactly once; 401/403 never retry. Port the same semantics here (see rtech-hermes packages/rtech-hermes-runtime/src/rtech_hermes_runtime/openbrain/http_transport.py for the reference implementation and fake-transport test patterns).
